retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant Y2K-era promotional layout featuring a central group of performers against a radial textured background with heavy, layered bubble typography.
triggerTerms: layered bubble lettering with thick outlines

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy composition featuring four female figures in dynamic poses, anchored by a large, multi-layered title logo at the top and a textured radial background that emanates from the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject figures arranged in a staggered, overlapping V-formation
Typography layered with thick contrasting strokes and drop shadows
Background texture mirroring the animal print motifs in the clothing
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a bright, saturated backdrop
coreInvariants: Radial halftone or animal print background pattern
Thick, multi-colored outlines on all display text
Integration of a star or geometric icon within the typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-body figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, purple-outlined title logo at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down through the central figure, and fans out to the flanking performers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright blue radial space surrounding the central cluster of subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple and black for outlines and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and orange cheetah print patterns
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and accents, with high value contrast between the white clothing and black garments.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, bouncy sans-serif with varying baseline heights
letterConstructionRules: Inner white stroke separating fill from outer border
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical characters filled with animal print textures
Dot of the 'i' replaced with a star icon
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine heavy bubble display type with a clean, small sans-serif for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, interlocking bubble aesthetic.
Provides the thick, geometric rounded skeleton needed for the base.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of four diverse female pop performers in Y2K fashion (black, white, and cheetah print) posing dynamically against a bright blue radial animal-print textured background. Leave the top third of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom bubble lettering in a stacked formation at the top center. Apply a thick purple outer stroke, a thin white middle stroke, and a purple fill. Incorporate a yellow star and a large number filled with cheetah print.

verificationChecks: Does the background have a radial texture?
Are the subjects in a V-formation?
Is the cheetah print pattern present in both clothing and graphics?

mustAchieve: Cohesive color palette across fashion and graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check for triple-stroke effect on display text
Verify radial pattern alignment with center of image
Ensure animal print textures are high-resolution
Confirm subjects do not overlap the main title legibility
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Textured Background + Staggered Group Portrait + Triple-Outlined Bubble Type = Y2K Pop Aesthetic
